# Public-data fixtures

Every file here is **synthetic**: hand-written, with a shape taken from
repository notes (EXP-0103 section 3.2 for EDGAR, the FRED/ALFRED doc page
names for ALFRED). They are **not recorded** from any publisher, **not
verified** against any primary source, and carry invented series ids,
filer ids, accession numbers and values.

They exist only so the offline parsers and the adapter can be tested without
a network. They may be replaced only by recordings made in WO-D21-5.
